_doc: The workload and shape corpus (plan P2): fixed cases over the existing drivers (--bench-json, --draft-lookup, the server, scripts/idle_coexistence.py), run by scripts/bench-corpus.py. Results are machine data and stay out of the repository: each record carries the machine, the model's identity, threads, the P1 route and whether the run was the first or a repeat, so two records compare only like with like. No thresholds: hosted runners are not measured.
